post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not select profitable ticker, sector or time buckets from this account history and call them alpha; do not substitute missing fees or unknown starting positions with zero.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A demonstrated accounting defect with a reproducer, or independently frozen decision-order-fill lineage for a new strategy-attribution consumer.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The broker already held useful execution facts but daily reports used a separate missing trade diary. A strict committed-ledger consumer makes a covered negative trading sample visible without changing the source or selecting rules from its outcomes.

production_impact: Read-only broker aggregation and daily report/JSON visibility only; signals, ranking, sizing, exits, fees assumptions and trading permissions unchanged.
